items.source:
This method extracts URI variable values from the request URI, builds the arguments
for the method call, invokes the method, and converts the result to a
ReadResourceResult.
items.translation: 该方法从请求 URI 中提取 URI 变量值，构建方法调用参数，执行方法调用，并将结果转换为 ReadResourceResult。

items.source: Class for creating BiFunction callbacks around resource methods with asynchronous processing for stateless contexts. This class provides a way to convert methods annotated with McpResource into callback functions that can be used to handle resource requests asynchronously in stateless environments. It supports various method signatures and return types, and handles URI template variables.
items.translation: 用于在状态无上下文中为资源方法创建具有异步处理的 BiFunction 回调的类。 该类提供了一种将带有 McpResource 注解的方法转换为回调函数的方法，这些回调函数可用于在状态无环境中异步处理资源请求。它支持多种方法签名和返回类型，并处理 URI 模板变量。
